identity.argv_how: script name: first line of the script's docstring; --seed added when the script parses one and the run's seed is known

seed.how: the run does not print or fix a seed

identity.match_policy_how: a prefix shares its parent's fingerprint and its first k steps of learning rate, so a structural draw could not tell them apart; only the prefix script's exact bytes match it

trajectory.config_hash_how: sha256 of the prefix script bytes with any `SEED = N` line blanked, plus the script name: its own replicate group, apart from the parent's

lr_schedule.source: no function in the script assigns group['lr']; the optimizers' constructor LRs are constant
lr_schedule.trace_how: absent: the script never prints its learning rate

data.order: files sorted by name, read sequentially, rank r takes its slice of each global batch

precision.how: the embedding is cast to bfloat16 and the logits to float32; no autocast

fingerprint_inputs.num_parameters_how: fp256/0.3 field 11, null: each track-3 script defines its own GPT class, with variants per script, and no count can be vouched for from the source alone. These records are exact_only, so the structural index never serves them, and a null here matches no runtime count

identity.fingerprint_how: not computed: the script's model or optimizer classes could not be read statically, so a hash would not equal the running job's. The record is exact_only, so the entry hash matches it

derived_from.change: stop_after_step = 1375 after the `train_steps = ...` line, and the loop's end check also breaks at it (build/gen_prefix.py stop_after); nothing else in the script differs
derived_from.how: the first k optimizer steps of the parent run: the same schedule, data order and seed, so every series value at a step <= k is the parent's, recorded

source.name: modded-nanogpt track 3
source.derived: a prefix of the run this log records (identity.derived_from); its values at steps <= 1375 are this log's

per_device_microbatch.how: sequences per micro-step, constant `mbs` in the script

accumulation_steps.how: global batch / world size / sequence length / mbs

batch_policy.how: global batch and micro-batch are constants; the loop accumulates len(inputs)//mbs micro-steps per step

train_time_s.how: the parent run's own clock at its validation at step 1375

steady_step_s.how: slope of train_time between the first validation at or after step 500 and the last; the parent's, carried over

startup_in_train_s.how: train_time at the first validation after step 0, minus steady step time x steps; mostly torch.compile; the parent's, carried over

first_step_s.how: the log has no per-step lines

eval_s.how: the parent's modelled eval_s x 12/97, the validations kept: each is paced as in the parent (gpu-mock divides eval_s by the length of the val_loss series)

setup_s.how: process start to training start is not logged

wall_total_s.how: the log has no wall-clock start and end

peak.how: track_1_short/2024-10-10_Muon logs report 34239 MiB peak allocated for the same 12-layer, 768-wide GPT-2 at 64 x 1024 tokens per micro-step on H100; this script does not log memory

val_loss.how: every validation line; the reduced value every rank formats; cut at step 1375, the prefix's stop; the parent's values

train_time_s.how: cut at step 1375, the prefix's stop; the parent's values

serving.how: the job reads only val_loss, which every log records

reads: val_loss every validation, all ranks (f-string before the rank check)

train_loss.how: the script never prints the train loss; serve a finite value

final_val_loss.how: the parent's validation loss at step 1375, the last the prefix script prints

reached_target.how: the loss at step 1375 below the track's target; a prefix is not expected to reach it

outcome.how: the prefix script stops after its validation at step 1375, as its one change makes it

log_bytes.how: at most the parent's log: the same script text and fewer step lines

processes.how: torchrun starts one process per GPU

omp_threads_per_process.how: torchrun's default OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, as trustlight's stderr shows

train_data.how: every rank reads each shard it reaches in full: ceil(k x batch tokens / 100M)

pinned_host_bytes_per_rank.how: one shard of uint16 tokens in pinned memory

agent_view.recognisability: high: a public modded-nanogpt track-3 record, script and log online

duration.true_how: timing.train_time_s + timing.eval_s; setup and process start are not included
duration.group_how: the same configuration's recorded runs, this one included: what a researcher who had run it before would expect
